metrics.label: Main content appears
metrics.note: Largest Contentful Paint. Google's line for good is 2.5 seconds.

metrics.label: Page is busy and cannot respond
metrics.note: Total Blocking Time. Under 200 ms is good.

metrics.label: Layout jumps while loading
metrics.note: Cumulative Layout Shift. Under 0.1 is good.

metrics.label: First thing appears
metrics.note: First Contentful Paint. Under 1.8 seconds is good.

metrics.label: Page looks complete
metrics.note: Speed Index. Under 3.4 seconds is good.

findings.title: 3rd parties
findings.description: 3rd party code can significantly impact load performance. Reduce and defer loading of 3rd party code to prioritize your page's content.

guides.description: Optimize the loading priority of scripts so critical code runs first and non-critical code does not delay the page.

findings.title: LCP request discovery
findings.description: Optimize LCP by making the LCP image discoverable from the HTML immediately, and avoiding lazy-loading.

guides.description: Optimize the loading priority of Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) candidate images and deprioritize non-critical images to reduce critical resource load delays.

findings.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
findings.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity.

guides.description: Identify the scripts that cost the most loading and main-thread time so they can be removed, deferred or replaced.

findings.title: Improve image delivery
findings.description: Reducing the download time of images can improve the perceived load time of the page and LCP.

guides.description: Deliver optimized images in modern formats and at several pixel densities so the browser can pick the best file for the device.

findings.title: Font display
findings.description: Consider setting font-display to swap or optional to ensure text is consistently visible.

guides.description: Load web fonts without layout shift by matching the fallback font's metrics to the web font.

findings.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
findings.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page.

guides.description: Actionable guidelines for optimizing modern web applications. Use this guide when auditing performance and optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).

findings.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
findings.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read.

guides.description: Pick a text color that stays readable against any background color.
